title: Lattice inclusions and rationalization survive scheme pullback
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with its $\ell$-adic topology and valuation ring $A=\mathcal O_E$ with the subspace topology [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For each scheme $T$ [def-pc-scheme], use its small pro-étale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], continuous coefficient ring sheaves $A_T(U)=C(|U|,A)$ and $E_T(U)=C(|U|,E)$ [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients], and sheaves of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Locally finite free means free of finite rank on a pro-étale cover, with varying ranks and rank zero allowed. Let $g:Y\to X$ be any scheme morphism. Let $L$ be a locally finite free $E_X$-module, $M$ a locally finite free $A_X$-module, and $i:M\to L$ an $A_X$-linear monomorphism whose induced map $E_X\otimes_{A_X}M\to L$ is an isomorphism [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Use canonical coefficient pullback, namely inverse image followed by scalar extension to the coefficient ring on $Y$ [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Then the induced map $g_A^*M\to g_E^*L$ is monic, both modules remain locally finite free, and its scalar-extension adjoint $E_Y\otimes_{A_Y}g_A^*M\to g_E^*L$ is an isomorphism. This adjoint is induced by the pulled-back inclusion itself.
